one_liner: Gorgias has a broad REST API using Basic auth (account email + API key) for private apps and mandatory OAuth2 for public 3rd-party apps; no MCP server confirmed by the pages.
auth_notes: OpenAPI security scheme is HTTP basic: email as username, API key as password. OAuth2 is mandatory for 3rd-party apps. Whether OAuth2 is self-serve for a non-partner is unclear; public apps need Developer Portal signup.
access_notes: Private apps need no approval, so per-customer API keys work immediately. Pages do not state whether a free tier or trial exists; a Gorgias account is presumably paid. Developer sandbox is offered via the Developer Portal.
blocker_notes: A multi-tenant OAuth2 public app requires Developer Portal signup and Gorgias review before listing. Per-customer private-app API keys avoid review but need per-customer setup.
